name: Ward's Berry Farm
tagline: Home – Wards Berry Farm, Sharon MA
description: In 614 South Main Street, MA, Ward's Berry Farm raises Pumpkins, Corn, Tomatoes, Flowers, and Sunflowers on a working farm. The harvest is typically at its peak in autumn. Visitors can find seasonal produce and farm-grown goods through autumn and summer. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Sep – Nov in this growing zone.
